# Kestrel releases

## 4.1.4 (2026-11-08)

- Fixes KSA-2026-07.

## 4.2.0 (2026-11-12)

- Exactly-once delivery for the S3 sink.
- Runs on Java 25.
- Java 17 is no longer supported; Java 21 is the minimum.

## 4.1.3 (2026-10-21)

- Fixes a checkpoint leak when a job is cancelled.

answers.text:
# KSA-2026-07: what happened and what we changed

Published 2026-11-14.

The bypass came from a header-based routing shortcut added in 4.0.0 for health checks. We removed the shortcut, added an authentication test for every admin route, and from 4.2.0 the admin API listens on localhost unless configured otherwise.

answers.title: Security advisory KSA-2026-07 | Kestrel
answers.text:
# Security advisory KSA-2026-07: authentication bypass in the admin API

Published 2026-11-08. Severity: high (CVSS 8.1).

An unauthenticated request with a crafted header could reach the admin API's job-cancel endpoint in Kestrel 4.0.0 to 4.1.3. Fixed in 4.1.4 and 4.2.0. Upgrade, or block the admin port from untrusted networks.
